title: Application contract
description: What an application must declare so the runner can drive it without knowing which one it is. Installed into the image at /container/app.d/<app>/app.yaml by build_<app>.sh, beside the prepare/launch/extract hooks. An app with no hooks at all is legal: an app.yaml with just app and binary gets you wall time and a placement verdict, which is the ten-minute entry point that makes the contract adoptable.

app.description: The name the runner is asked for. Must match the app.d directory.

version.description: Recorded in every result row. A @PLACEHOLDER@ is substituted by build_<app>.sh at install time.

binary.description: Absolute path inside the image. Required unless there is a launch hook, which may pick a different executable and add flags.

primary_fom.description: Which figure of merit decides a comparison. Must name a key in figures_of_merit. Read host-side by hpcrun/collect, from the app.yaml copied into the results directory.

openmp.description: false means a thread sweep measures nothing for this app -- rank count is the axis that matters.

gpu.description: The GPU runtime the app needs. hpcrun/validate and hpcrun/submit refuse it on a node type without such GPUs, and apps/smoke.sh resolves the contract and runs prepare and launch, then skips the run, on a host with none.

gpu_aware_mpi.description: The app passes device buffers to MPI. On a node type with NVIDIA GPUs and Cray MPICH the launcher then sets MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=1, unless a variant sets it first. Off by default because it costs host-buffer messages about 6.5 us each (GpuNodesPlan.md, step 0). Requires gpu.

host_software.description: Host software, by name from the cluster description's host_software:, that the app runs from -- a binary whose license keeps it out of any image, or a library the site maintains. The launcher binds each into the container for this app's jobs; hpcrun/validate and hpcrun/submit refuse a cluster that lacks one, or whose path does not exist for the image's MPI family.

figures_of_merit.description: Ramble's noun, on purpose. Every key that extract may print, plus wall_s which the runner always provides.

better.description: Which direction wins. hpcrun/collect ranks with this; without it a metric is assumed higher-is-better, which is wrong for a latency.

app_self_validates.description: When true, extract must print valid=true|false. A valid=false row is recorded but never wins a comparison.

notes.description: Free text for whoever reads a results directory a year from now: what the numbers mean, and what would make them not mean it.
